description: This file defines the BudgetsRepository class, which provides an interface to access and modify budget data through a data source. It interacts with a LocalMockDataSource to retrieve and update budget information.

classes.name: BudgetsRepository
classes.description: Provides access to budget data, allowing retrieval and updates via a local mock data source.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all budgets from the data source.

methods.name: setBudget
methods.description: Updates the budget limit for a specific category in the data source.
